options.content:
This dashboard provides a comprehensive view of test execution statistics across manual and automated test cycles. It tracks automation coverage, cycle execution status, functional area coverage and label-based coverage — supporting quality reporting, sprint planning and audit readiness.

Dashboard Variables & Filters
Version
Select the release or patch version to scope all results — e.g. 4.14.0 (release) or 4.13.1 (patch).
Team
Filter by team to view their execution results — e.g. Team A, Team B, Team Alpha.
Cycle Type
SprintRegression — regression run during an active sprint.
Regression — regression run during a hardening sprint.

targets.rawSql:
WITH categorized_cycles AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        tcs.item_id,
        tcs.version,
        tcs.teams_set,
        CASE WHEN tcs.cycle_short_name LIKE '%Baseline%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS baseline,
        CASE WHEN tcs.cycle_short_name LIKE '%Automated%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS automated,
        CASE WHEN tcs.cycle_name NOT LIKE '%Automated%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS manual
    FROM athena.mv_test_cycle_statistics tcs
    WHERE 
        tcs.cycle_name $cycle_type '%Regression%' 
        AND tcs.project_code = 'DEMO' 
        AND tcs.version = '$version'
        AND tcs.teams_set ? '$team'
        AND item_execution_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    t.version,
    SUM(t.automated) AS "Automated",
    SUM(t.manual) AS "Manual",
    SUM(t.baseline) AS "Dev Automated"
FROM categorized_cycles t
GROUP BY t.version
ORDER BY SUM(t.automated + t.manual + t.baseline)

SELECT 
    cycle_short_name AS "Test Cycle",
    SUM(pass + "blocked" + skipped + fail) / Sum(total)::float * 100 AS "Total Executed"
FROM athena.mv_test_cycle_statistics
WHERE cycle_name ${cycle_type} '%Regression%' 
    AND project_code = 'DEMO' 
    AND version = '$version'
    AND teams_set ? '$team'
    AND cycle_name NOT LIKE '%Automated%' 
GROUP BY cycle_short_name

SELECT 
    cycle_short_name AS "Test Cycle",
    SUM(pass + "blocked" + skipped + fail) / Sum(total)::float * 100 AS "Total Executed"
FROM athena.mv_test_cycle_statistics
WHERE cycle_name $cycle_type '%Regression%' 
    AND project_code = 'DEMO' 
    AND version = '$version'
    AND teams_set ? '$team'
    AND cycle_short_name LIKE '%Automated%' 
GROUP BY cycle_short_name

SELECT
    m.item_key,
    MIN(m."name") AS name,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m.cycle_name, ', ') AS cycle_names,
    COUNT(m.fail) AS fail_count
FROM athena.mv_test_cycle_statistics m
WHERE m.version = '$version'
  AND m.cycle_short_name LIKE '%Automated%'
  AND (m.cycle_name $cycle_type '%Regression%' OR m.cycle_name LIKE '%Automated Team%')
  AND m.teams_set::jsonb ? '$team'
  AND m.item_status NOT IN ('Obsolete', 'Archived')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM athena.mv_test_cycle_statistics p
        WHERE p.item_key = m.item_key
          AND p.version = '$version'
          AND p.cycle_short_name LIKE '%Automated%'
          AND (p.cycle_name $cycle_type '%Regression%' OR p.cycle_name LIKE '%Automated Team%')
          AND (p.pass = 1)
    )
GROUP BY 
    m.item_key;

select item_key, item_status, name, cycle_code, cycle_short_name, executed_on, executor, execution_status from athena.mv_test_cycle_statistics
WHERE cycle_name LIKE '%Automated Team%' 
  AND project_code = 'DEMO' 
  AND item_execution_rank = 1
  AND version = '$version'
  AND teams_set ? '$team'
  AND cycle_short_name LIKE '%Automated%'
  AND item_status != 'Automated'

select item_key, item_status, name, cycle_code, cycle_short_name, executed_on, executor, execution_status, folder_set from athena.mv_test_cycle_statistics
WHERE cycle_name LIKE '%Automated Team%' 
  AND project_code = 'DEMO' 
  AND item_execution_rank = 1
  AND version = '$version'
  AND teams_set ? '$team'
  AND folder_set ? '/Automated Test Cases'
  AND cycle_short_name LIKE '%Automated%'

WITH daily AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', executed_on) AS hour,
        cycle_short_name AS "Test Cycle",
        SUM(pass + "blocked" + skipped + fail) / MAX(cycle_size)::float * 100 AS "Total Executed"
    FROM athena.mv_test_cycle_statistics
    WHERE cycle_name $cycle_type '%Regression%' 
      AND project_code = 'DEMO' 
      AND version = '$version'
      AND teams_set ? '$team'
      AND cycle_name NOT LIKE '%Automated%' 
      AND executed_on IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', executed_on), cycle_short_name
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(hour, NOW()) AS "time",
    "Test Cycle" AS metric,
    SUM("Total Executed") OVER (
        PARTITION BY "Test Cycle"
        ORDER BY COALESCE(hour, NOW())
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS value
FROM daily
ORDER BY "time", "Test Cycle";

WITH daily AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', executed_on) AS hour,
        cycle_short_name AS "Test Cycle",
        SUM(pass + "blocked" + skipped + fail) / MAX(cycle_size)::float * 100 AS "Total Executed"
    FROM athena.mv_test_cycle_statistics
    WHERE cycle_name $cycle_type  '%Regression%' 
      AND project_code = 'DEMO' 
      AND version = '$version'
      AND teams_set ? '$team'
      AND cycle_short_name LIKE '%Automated%' 
      AND executed_on IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', executed_on), cycle_short_name
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(hour, NOW()) AS "time",
    "Test Cycle" AS metric,
    SUM("Total Executed") OVER (
        PARTITION BY "Test Cycle"
        ORDER BY COALESCE(hour, NOW())
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS value
FROM daily
ORDER BY "time", "Test Cycle";

SELECT cycle_short_name, count(*) AS total, sum(pass) AS pass, sum(fail) AS fail, sum(skipped) AS skipped, sum(blocked) AS blocked

panels.title: Tests In Dev Automation Test Cycles

options.content:
What this table shows:

This table lists test case counts for various functional areas within the application, broken down by execution type (manual or automated) and associated execution status. Each row represents a specific functional area.

Why it matters:

It provides visibility into how testing efforts are distributed across different parts of the application. This present the team functional area expertises and helps ensure that all critical areas receive adequate coverage during regression and hardening phases.

How to interpret:

Since we follow a risk-based testing approach, different functional areas may have varying levels of risk impact. While generally, a high-risk area might have more automated tests for faster feedback, it is still possible that some complex areas may still require manual checks.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    area AS functional_area,
    sum(CASE WHEN cycle_short_name LIKE '%Baseline%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS baseline,
    sum(CASE WHEN cycle_short_name LIKE '%Automated%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS automated,
    sum(CASE WHEN cycle_name NOT LIKE '%Automated%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manual,
    SUM(pass) AS "Pass",
    SUM(fail) AS "Fail",
    SUM(blocked) AS "Blocked",
    SUM(in_progress) AS "InProgress",
    SUM(skipped) AS "Skipped",
    SUM(unexecuted) AS "Unexecuted",
    SUM(in_progress + unexecuted) AS "Total Unexecuted",
    COUNT(*) - SUM(in_progress + unexecuted) AS "Total Executed",
    SUM(total) AS "Total"
FROM athena.mv_test_cycle_statistics
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(functional_area_set) AS area
WHERE cycle_name $cycle_type '%Regression%' 
  AND project_code = 'DEMO' 
  AND version = '$version'
  AND teams_set ? '$team'
  AND item_execution_rank = 1
GROUP BY area
ORDER BY area
LIMIT 10000
